title: PhD fellowship
description:
About the position 

A 100% 3-year PhD fellowship in chromatin and computational biology is available in the project group of Dr. Julia Madsen-Østerbye, research group of Prof. Philippe Collas, at the Division of Biochemistry, Department of Molecular Medicine, Institute of Basic Medical Sciences, University of Oslo (Collas Lab). The position is part of an interdisciplinary project investigating epigenomic mechanisms by which mutations in nuclear lamins cause lipodystrophies and associated metabolic diseases.


More about the position 

You will be expected to carry out wet-lab 3D genomics experiments and analyze data in the context of additional datasets (RNA-seq, ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq, protein interactome, etc.) to investigate the impact of lamin mutations on spatial genome organization in lipodystrophy patient-derived cells. You will be expected to carry out advanced computational analyses. Our underlying model system is the in vitro differentiation of adipose tissue stem cells into adipocytes.

The project is in collaboration with the Danish Cancer Institute in Copenhagen, and you will have the opportunity to undertake a research stay in Copenhagen.

You will be part of a cross-disciplinary team of cell biologists and bioinformaticians in the Division of Biochemistry at the Department of Molecular Medicine. The Division hosts an active community of cell biologists working on, among other areas, chromatin and nuclear architecture using various model systems (BIO). 

You will take part in the Medical Faculty’s PhD program and be expected to complete the project and PhD within three years.


Responsibilities
  • Carry out wet-lab genomics work
  • Carry out computational analyses and interpret data
  • Maintain an accurate electronic laboratory journal
  • Present research findings at group meetings, seminars and conferences
  • Contribute to manuscript preparation
  • Complete the required medical faculty’s doctoral coursework
  • Write, submit and defend your PhD thesis

 Qualifications requirements
  • Applicants must hold a Master’s degree or equivalent in chromatin/genome biology, minimum grade B (ECTS grading scale) or equivalent. The Master’s degree must include a thesis of at least 30 ECTS. 
  • Programming skills in Python, R or equivalent scientific computing languages.
  • Experience in bioinformatic analysis of genomic data. 
  • Excellent English written and oral communication skills.
  • Experience with 3D chromatin conformation capture methods (practical and/or computational) is a plus.
  • Experience with electronic laboratory notebook systems is a plus.

Personal skills
  • A positive and systematic mindset.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn new skills.
  • Collaborative and enjoys working as part of a team.
  • Good communication skills with molecular biology researchers, technicians, and bioinformaticians.
  • Contributes to a collegial and inclusive working environment. 

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

 

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

 


We offer 

 

  • Committed colleagues in an active, international and interdisciplinary research environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Doctoral Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

 

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include: 

  • A cover letter including a statement of motivation and interests for this PhD position. 
  • A CV summarizing education, positions and relevant work experience 
  • Copies of educational certificates and transcript records. Foreign applicants must attach an explanation of the grading system in their university.
  • A list of publications and academic works; do not include the publications or your dissertation.
  • List of 3 reference persons: name, relation to you and contact information (e-mail and phone number). 

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click “Apply for the position”. 

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no, if educated in Norway. If not, you must upload copies of your University transcripts or grades. All documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.
 

  When evaluating the application, emphasis will be placed on your motivation, academic and personal prerequisites to carry out the project. The best qualified applicants will be called in for an interview. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Basic Medical Sciences overall objective is to promote basic medical knowledge in order to understand normal processes, provide insight into mechanisms that cause illness, and promote good health. The Institute is responsible for teaching in basic medical sciences for the programmes of professional study in medicine and the Master's programme in clinical nutrition. The Institute has more than 300 employees and is located in Domus Medica.

Ser du muligheter der andre kanskje ser begrensninger? 

Nav Eiganes og Tasta har ledig en fast stilling som veileder i vårt team for oppfølging av voksne over 30 år som står helt eller delvis utenfor arbeidslivet. Vi søker deg som er trygg i møte med mennesker i ulike livssituasjoner, og som evner å være raus, tålmodig og tydelig. Du brenner for å skape muligheter i arbeidslivet, og er ikke er redd for å ta kontakt med arbeidsgivere for å åpne dører for dem vi følger opp. 
 
I denne rollen vil du kartlegge den enkeltes ressurser, muligheter og behov, og bidra til at flere kommer nærmere arbeid, tiltak og utdanning. En viktig del av jobben er å motivere og støtte mennesker gjennom endringsprosesser, styrke troen på egne muligheter og bidra til mestring på veien mot økt deltakelse i arbeidslivet. Du vil samarbeide tett med lokalt næringsliv og andre samarbeidspartnere for å finne gode løsninger, samtidig som du forvalter Nav sitt regelverk og saksbehandler i henhold til gjeldende lover og retningslinjer.

Kontoret er lokalisert i Byfjordparken 15 på Tasta. Vi har cellekontor, små lukkede landskap med 2 til 4 medarbeidere og et større åpent landskap. Kontoret disponerer biler som brukes til ekstern møtevirksomhet.

Hvis du ønsker en meningsfull jobb med varierte arbeidsoppgaver, faglige utfordringer og gode utviklingsmuligheter, håper vi at du søker på stillingen som veileder hos oss.
Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Gi helhetlig arbeidsrettet oppfølging og veiledning til personer med behov for bistand mot arbeid eller utdanning.
  • Kartlegge ressurser og behov, utarbeide planer og bidra til mestring og utvikling i endringsprosesser.
  • Samarbeide med arbeidsgivere, utdanningsinstitusjoner og andre aktører for å fremme inkludering i arbeid og aktivitet.
  • Saksbehandle og forvalte Nav sine tjenester, virkemidler og regelverk, samt veilede i bruk av digitale løsninger.
  • Dokumentere oppfølging og sikre god kvalitet i veilednings- og forvaltningsarbeidet.

Nav er i stadig utvikling og endring. Det må derfor påregnes at andre oppgaver kan bli lagt til stillingen ved behov, herunder tilknytning til annen avdeling eller annet team.

Kvalifikasjoner

Du må ha:

  • Fullført utdanning tilsvarende bachelorgrad fra universitet eller høyskole, gjerne innen sosialfag, samfunnsfag, pedagogikk, arbeids- og velferdsfag, psykologi eller andre relevante fagområder. Relevant erfaring og/eller utdanning kan kompensere for utdanningskravet. Utenlandske utdanningsgrader må være godkjent av Hk-dir eller Nokut og godkjenningen må lastes opp som vedlegg til søknaden. 
  • God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne med gode norskkunnskaper. Ved annet morsmål enn norsk, må det dokumenteres språknivå tilsvarende minst B2.
  • God digital kompetanse og evne til å ta i bruk nye systemer og arbeidsverktøy. Gjerne erfaring med Microsoft 365.
  • Erfaring med veiledning og motivering av mennesker, fortrinnsvis mot arbeid, tiltak og/eller utdanning. 

Det er også en fordel om du har: 

  • Erfaring fra å kontakte bedrifter og / eller har erfaring fra å samarbeide med eksterne samarbeidspartnere.
  • Erfaring med saksbehandling og lovanvendelse.

Vi er mer opptatt av hva du kan, dine erfaringer og kompetanse, enn hvor flink du er til å skrive en jobbsøknad. Derfor ber vi deg om å levere en god og beskrivende CV hvor du får frem hva du har gjort og oppnådd som gjør deg kvalifisert for stillingen du søker på. I tillegg kommer vi til å be deg svare på noen korte spørsmål, som en del av søknadsprosessen. Du trenger altså ikke å skrive eller legge ved et søknadsbrev. 

Personlige egenskaper

For at du skal kunne oppleve mestring og trives i rollen over tid, ser vi det som svært viktig at du innehar disse personlige egenskapene i stor grad:

  • Samarbeider med andre: Du bygger gode relasjoner og samarbeider godt med både kolleger, arbeidsgivere og andre samarbeidspartnere.
  • Tar Initiativ: Du handler på eget initiativ og tar selvstendige avgjørelser. 
  • Tilpasningsdyktig: Du omprioriterer arbeid når omstendighetene krever det og har et friskt blikk på nye situasjoner og endringer, uten å feste deg ved eksisterende.
  • Planlegger og strukturerer: Du arbeider systematisk, håndterer flere saker samtidig og sikrer kvalitet i oppfølging og saksbehandling.
  • Motstandsdyktig: Du står trygt i krevende situasjoner, håndterer motgang på en konstruktiv måte og bevarer ro og fokus i en hektisk arbeidshverdag. 

Personlige egenskaper vektlegges sterkt, og det vil bli benyttet DNV-GL-sertifisert personlighetstest i rekrutteringsprosessen. 

Vi tilbyr
  • En spennende arbeidshverdag med varierte og givende arbeidsoppgaver.
  • Dyktige medarbeidere og et godt arbeidsmiljø.
  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter, blant annet relevante kurs og videreutdanning innen eksempelvis Forvaltningsrett og kollegaveiledning.

title: Postdoctoral Fellow
description:
Job description

Applicants are invited for a three- or four- year Postdoc position at the Department of Education, University of Oslo.

We are seeking a candidate with deep insight and interest in investigating the interaction between collaborative learning processes in specific knowledge domains in educational sciences and AI tools and infrastructures.

Different types of AI (generative and domain specific intelligent technologies) change the conditions for student learning in higher education. The position is anchored in the learning sciences a field in rapid development. The field needs to improve both descriptions, understanding, and explanations about the interaction that takes place between students, content, context and AI. The learning sciences is an interdisciplinary field of knowledge, building on learning-theoretical principles but also capitalizing on research from various other subfields – educational psychology, sociology of education, design studies or computer science, and more recently, learning analytics and AI in education.

GenAI have the last years changed important parts of the knowledge infrastructures for students in  higher education. Multiple resources contribute to form their learning trajectories. To navigate and use multiple resources increases the complexity for students learning processes and demands for agency and cognitive efforts change.  Today we have limited insight into students’ processes and outcomes with AI within specific areas in higher education.

This postdoc project is planned as design-based research (DBR) study based on different AI tools and infrastructures. Design-based research is a specific design approach that has been developed in the learning sciences over the last 30 years. It implies that researchers and practitioners collaborate in the design, implementation and analysis of the project. They will usually have different roles in the different phases of the projects, and a DBR study usually runs in several iterations to improve the students’ learning opportunities.

The project will be implemented in collaboration with the senior members of the KITE research group (se link to KITE below) and, if relevant, members of other research groups at the Faculty of Educational Sciences.  

The study will be conducted with students at the Faculty of Educational Sciences and, if relevant during the project period, with students from other faculties at University of Oslo.

The project will be part of the portfolio of KITE’s AI related projects in the TRUST center (se link below).  Applicants are strongly encouraged to contact the contact persons for guidance in the preparation of their application and project proposal. 


More about the position

The appointment is a fulltime position for a period of three or four years. In a four-year position 25% of the time is devoted to teaching duties, usually in the form of teaching activities at the department. The main purpose of the fellowship is to build a research profile and competence that qualifies the postdoctoral fellow to apply for a position as associate professor within their disciplines. The position will also provide other competence with relevance for the postdoctoral fellow's further career.

Please see the guidelines concerning appointments to post-doctoral and research positions at the University of Oslo.

If the Postdoctoral Fellow does not already have educational qualifications that meet the requirements for an associate professor position, UiO shall facilitate the acquisition of such competence during the employment period.

A career plan shall be developed for the Postdoctoral Fellow, specifying the competencies the Postdoctoral Fellow should acquire. UiO is responsible for following up on the career plan and ensuring that the Postdoctoral Fellow has access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral term. 

The appointed postdoc will be part of the faculty research group KITE, which conducts research on knowledge work, collaboration and learning with emerging technologies in higher education and in work settings. The group has an extensive national and international network of researchers and user partners and participants in the AI-centre TRUST (The Norwegian Centre for Trustworthy AI - TRUST – The Norwegian Centre for Trustworthy AI).


Qualification requirements
  • The applicants would need to have PhD in either; learning sciences, educational sciences, educational psychology or human-computer interactions studies.   
  • The focus of the PhD-thesis needs to contain knowledge areas such as learning theory, cognitive theories with applications on studies of learning, design of learning environments, design-based research methods, digitalization and AI preferable in higher education, but background in K-12 studies might also be of relevance. Applicants with PhD thesis that involves studies of interaction with intelligent technologies will be given priority. 
  • Doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Appointment is dependent on the public defense of the doctoral thesis being approved. 
  • Proficiency in English is required. Fluent and written communication in Norwegian would be seen as an advantage in the work with the study design and data analysis. 

Personal skills
  • Strong collaborative and communication skills
  • A commitment to work towards the project’s common goals
  • Ability to work focused and independently
     

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon applicants with diverse background, variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for colleagues that could contribute to advanced research in the field of collaborative learning with AI. 

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A professionally stimulating working environment
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range from NOK 595.000 - to NOK 670.000 per annum -, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.
  • Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.

How to apply

Your application should include:

  • Cover letter that includes statement of motivation, summarizes scientific work and project proposal within research area described above. Applicants are strongly encouraged to contact the contact persons for guidance in the preparation of their application a project description of 7-8 pages, including a progress plan, which should outline 3-4 scientific articles/papers. 
  • Applicants are asked to outline a postdoc project that includes their interest towards collaborative learning and AI in higher education. They must formulate a project proposal with a clear theoretical framing, research methods, description of design processes, data analysis and justification of relevant research questions. 
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copy of PhD Diploma or documentation of thesis submission. Applicants who have not yet defended their PhD dissertation need to include an advisor’s letter confirming specific expectations about when the degree will be received 
  • Copies of educational certificates (academic transcripts only), 
  • a complete list of publications, 
  • academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered, 
  • a list of reference persons: 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number). 

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system Jobbnorge. Foreign applicants are advised to attach an explanation of their university’s grading system. Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language).

Incomplete applications will not be assessed.

In assessing the applications, special emphasis will be placed on the documented, academic qualifications, the project description, and the quality of the project as well as the candidate’s motivation and personal suitability. Interviews with the best qualified candidates will be arranged.

It is expected that the successful candidate will be able to complete the project during the period of employment. 


Formal regulations

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 27 400 students and 6 900 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of Education  was established in 1938 and is one of three departments at the Faculty of Educational Sciences. title: Østensjø Rederi søker Marine Superintendent
description:
Østensjø Rederi søker en proaktiv og strukturert Marine Superintendent til vårt Risk and Compliance-team ved hovedkontoret i Haugesund. Rollen rapporterer til Risk and Compliance Manager og har en sentral funksjon i oppfølgingen av vår flåte. Du vil bidra til at selskapets styringssystem, HMS- og kvalitetsstandarder og operative rutiner opprettholdes og videreutvikles.

Ansvarsområde

Som Marine Superintendent vil du bistå med utarbeidelse, implementering og vedlikehold av selskapets styringssystem. Du vil ha en variert arbeidshverdag med oppgaver innen HMS og kvalitet, revisjoner, granskninger, rapportering og oppfølging av hendelser og korrigerende tiltak.

Du vil samarbeide tett med flåtesjefer og mannskap, og bidra med råd og støtte innen HMS, kvalitet og fartøysoperasjoner. Stillingen innebærer også ansvar for månedlig rapportering til befraktere og for å sikre at mannskapet får nødvendig sikkerhets-, beredskaps- og opplæring i selskapets styringssystem.

Ved behov vil du kunne opptre som selskapets Designated Person Ashore (DPA) og/eller Company Security Officer (CSO).

Hvem er du?

Vi ser etter en strukturert og ansvarsbevisst kollega som arbeider grundig og systematisk, og som har god gjennomføringsevne. Du er proaktiv og løsningsorientert, og trives med å jobbe selvstendig samtidig som du samarbeider godt med både sjø- og landbasert personell.

Du har god forståelse for maritime operasjoner og evner å kombinere kravene i styringssystemet med praktiske løsninger i den operative hverdagen. Du kommuniserer godt, både muntlig og skriftlig, og har svært gode engelskkunnskaper.

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Operativ erfaring fra maritim virksomhet og god teknisk forståelse
  • Kjennskap til maritimt regelverk
  • Erfaring fra HMS- og kvalitetsarbeid
  • Relevant utdanning på høyskole- eller fagskolenivå
  • Svært gode skriftlige og muntlige engelskkunnskaper

Hvorfor Østensjø Rederi?

Hos Østensjø Rederi blir du en del av et solid og anerkjent rederi med lang historie, sterke verdier og høy teknisk standard. Vi tilbyr:

  • Et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med dyktige kolleger
  • En spennende arbeidshverdag i et kompetent og profesjonelt team
  • Stor grad av autonomi og mulighet til å påvirke og bidra til kontinuerlig forbedring
  • Konkurransedyktige lønns- og arbeidsvilkår, samt gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
  • Moderne kontorlokaler på kaien i hjertet av Haugesund
  • En trygg og stabil arbeidsplass med lojale og dedikerte medarbeidere

Østensjø Rederi er en ledende internasjonal leverandør av offshore-tjenester, og eier og opererer skip innen Offshore Energy, Offshore Accommodation og taubåtsektoren. Siden starten i 1974 er rederiet bygget opp med fokus på høykvalitets leveranser i alle ledd og langvarige samarbeidspartnere. Dette har lagt grunnlaget for de gode kunderelasjoner selskapet har i dag samt en dyktig og solid arbeidsstyrke, både på land og til sjøs. Østensjø Rederi er familieeid og har rundt 500 ansatte. Selskapt har hovedkontor i Haugesund, samt tilstedeværelse i Storbritannia og på Malta.

title: Avdelingleder hjemmetjenesten
description:
Vil du være med å forme framtidens helsetjenester i Klepp kommune?

Klepp kommune har ambisjoner for utviklingen av framtidens helsetjenester. Vi står i et tydelig skifte der behovene øker, ressursene blir knappere, og kravene til samhandling, endring og bærekraft blir sterkere. Dette krever nye løsninger, nye arbeidsformer og tydelig ledelse.
Vi søker nå en avdelingsleder for hjemmetjenester  – en nøkkelrolle i utviklingen av helse- og omsorgstjenester for innbyggerne i Klepp.

Vil du bli avdelingsleder i hjemmetjenesten?

Vi ser etter en motivert og engasjert avdelingsleder i hjemmetjenesten. En leder som ønsker å skape gode tjenester sammen med dyktige medarbeidere. En som vil bidra til å videreutvikle hjemmetjenesten og sikre trygge og helsefremmende tjenester for innbyggerne våre.

Avdelingsleder inngår i virksomhetens ledergruppe og rapporterer til virksomhetsleder.


Arbeidsoppgåver
  • Budsjett-, økonomi-, personal- og fagansvar
  • Daglig drift av avdelingen, turnusplanlegging og ressursstyring av cirka 25 årsverk
  • Bidra til at tjenesten når mål og resultatkrav
  • Utvikle tjenesten i tråd med virksomhetsplan og sentrale og nasjonale føringer
  • Ansvar for at tjenesten utøves i samsvar med kvalitetskrav og lovverk
  • Samhandle tverrfaglig på tvers av avdelinger
  • Oppfølging og veiledning av ansatte, og utvikle/opprettholde et godt arbeidsmijlø
  • Rekruttering og opplæring av ansatte
Kvalifikasjonar
  • 3-årig helse og sosialfaglig høyskole (bachelor) 
  • Formell lederutdanning, eller påbegynt utdanning innen 2 år etter oppstart
  • Ledererfaring
  • Høy grad av økonomiforståelse og erfaring med budsjettansvar
  • Erfaring med endrings-og utviklingsarbeid
  • Kjenne til lovverk for tjenesteområdet
  • Ønskelig med erfaring innenfor helse
  • Ønskelig med erfaring i bruk av velferdsteknologi
  • Gode dokumentasjonsferdigheter
  • Beherske ulike systemer og dataverktøy
  • Beherske norsk godt, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Attester og vitnemål:
    Vi ber om at du laster opp attester og vitnemål i PDF-format samen med søknaden din.
Personlege eigenskapar
  • Gode lederegenskaper, en tydelig trygg og samlende leder
  • Kunne jobbe selvstendig og målretta
  • Stor arbeidskapasitet og er robust
  • Samarbeider og kommuniserer godt
  • God på relasjonsbygging og skape tillit
  • Pålitelig og ansvarsbevisst
  • Nærværende leder med evne til å inspirere og motivere
  • Evner å stå i kompleksitet og gjennomføre endringer
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.
Vi tilbyr
  • Faglig og personlig utvikling
  • Engasjert lederteam som samarbeider på tvers av avdelinger
  • Faglig dyktige, erfarne og engasjerte medarbeidere
  • Inkluderende arbeidsplass
  • Lønn etter avtale
  • Gode forsikrings- og pensjonsordninger (https://www.klp.no/pensjon/offentlig-tjenestepensjon-kort-fortalt)
  • Gratis parkering
  • Gratis adgang i bassenget i Klepphallen, ved gitte tider
  • Bedriftskunstforening
  •  Ordning med refusjon for behandling hos fysioterapeut og kiropraktor

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Klepp er den største av kommunane på Jæren, med over 21 000 innbyggarar og om lag 1800  tilsette. Me ligg sentralt til, med korte avstander både til Stavanger, Sandnes og Bryne.

Kommunen vår har dei flottaste strendene i heile regionen, me har ein spennande kulturhistorie, og ei god blanding av landbruk, industri og varehandel.

Visjonen vår er «Med blikk for alle».  Me ønskjer tilsette som tek i eit tak, bryr seg og tenkjer fritt, og me oppmodar alle kvalifiserte til å søkja, uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn.

Me gjer merksam på at søkarlister kan verta offentleggjort, sjølv om ein har bede om å bli unntatt offentlegheit. Søkar vil verta varsla før offentleggjering.

As a Business Development Representative with German-English working Hybrid in Krakow, Poland, you’ll be a part of bringing humanity to business. #experienceTTEC

Our employees have spoken. Our purpose, team, and company culture are amazing and our Great Place to Work® certification in Poland says it all!

What You'll be Doing

Looking to build long term relationships as a trusted advisor? Do you have a passion to maximize sales opportunities over the long term? You'll deliver amazing customer service and uncover sales opportunities for our technology client's customers. With a consultative selling approach and focus on revenue targets, you'll cultivate existing customer relationships while establishing and maintaining long-term relationships. You'll work both independently and collaboratively with a cross-functional team to identify and solve business technology needs in a cloud-based environment.

You'll report to the Operations Sales Manager. You’ll contribute to the success of the customer experience as well as the overall success of the team.

During a Typical Day, You'll

- Bring your passion to negotiate with brand knowledge to close a sale, handle objections and rebuttals during customer interactions
- Recommend, quote, and negotiate product knowledge with customers to close the sale while identifying and handling all sales opportunities
- Build a healthy sales pipeline to achieve main targets
- Support customers ranging from small to medium size businesses or advertising agencies and C-Level business contacts supporting cloud-based technology
- Bring your curiosity to stay on top of the trends in the technology industry

What You Bring to the Role

- Experience prospecting, developing accounts, negotiating, and closing deals
- Develop partnerships and communicate with high-level decision makers to assess needs
- Some understanding of cloud-based software
- Verbal and written proficiency in both German (minimum B2+/C1 level) and English (minimum B2 level)
- 1+ years demonstrated sales experience
- A solution-oriented mindset and comfortable working to resolve issues before escalating to the next level
- Reside in or able to relocate to the Krakow area

What You Can Expect

- Generous relocation package of 10.000 PLN gross
- Base salary of 11.000 PLN plus performance-related bonuses opportunities
- MyBenefit - Kafeteria
- PPK Plan
- Employee Referral program
- VISA and Work Permit reimbursement if needed
- Additional days of annual leave
- Private Luxmed medical care including dental care and eye care plan (glasses reimbursement)
- Multisport Card
- Flexible working hours and additional days of annual leave
- Partial language course reimbursement program as well as tuition program for sales courses and studies

title: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description:
Operations and technicians

Teamlead Reliability Engineers

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.Pre-employment background checks:For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

Project Manager / Delivery Assurance for SAP and Service Now (f/m/d)

Full or part time

At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we drive innovation – from advisory and implementation to managed services and beyond, powered by a global team of over 18,500 experts representing over 90 nations in more than 30 countries. With SAP at our core and a powerful ecosystem of partners like Microsoft and ServiceNow, we continuously improve solutions and AI-driven technology to make them work for companies – and for their people.

We are part of NTT DATA, a $30+ billion business and technology services, AI and digital infrastructure leader. As a Global Top Employer, NTT DATA serves 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and, with experts in over 70 countries, co-innovates solutions that encourage experimentation and recognize great work.

With us, you have endless opportunities to think big, act bold and take ownership. Make this the place where you belong, learn, and build your network.

**Make this the place where you grow

**Location: **Germany, Poland, Bulgaria or Romania

What makes us special:

We have a holistic view of the individual needs of our employees. Here (https://nttdata-solutions.com/de/karriere/benefits/)  you can find a detailed overview of our wide variety of benefits during different life phases.

■ Flexible working hours and locations: workation, mobile working, part-time models, sabbaticals, etc.

■ Your further development by plan: topic-specific induction, targeted career development based on career models, programs and your own academy

■ Family first: e.g. daycare allowance, paid maternity leave and paternity network

■ SAP Platinum Partnership: strong SAP partnership, large knowledge network, and SAP Learning Hub and certification opportunities.

■ We take care: e.g. 25% subsidy for company pension plan, company health management and cooperation with fitness providers

■ We help you get from A to B: company car (depending on your role), discount on public transport and bicycle leasing via JobRad®.

Do you love challenges?

As Project / Delivery Assurance Manager for SAP and ServiceNow Projects and Managed Services, you will be responsible for:

■ Conducting risk and quality assessments for new and existing large customer engagements, ensuring SAP and ServiceNow-specific risks are addressed.

■ Providing feedback on the Deal Governance process to ensure that new projects and services meet agreed standards and quality expectations.

■ Supporting Red/Amber projects by developing and executing "Back to Green" action plans, including internal management reporting.

■ Managing customer escalations: leading top management customer escalations, supporting executive management in the de-escalation process, addressing root causes, and restoring customer confidence.

■ Defining the necessary quality checks for SAP and ServiceNow projects and services to ensure quality, speed and profitability

Convince us with your potential!

■ Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field

Several years of work experience in Delivery Assurance, Project and/or Services Management proves your:

■ Expertise in SAP and ServiceNow within complex enterprise environments

■ Delivery assurance skills, supported by certification (e.g. Six Sigma)

■ Strong project/service management and leadership abilities

■ Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach

■ Excellent communication and collaboration skills with technical and business stakeholders

■ Commitment to continuous improvement, attention to detail, and adaptability under pressure

■ Knowledge of IT standards and regulations (ISO 9001, CMMI, GDPR)

■ Proficiency in written and spoken English and German

1) Wykształcenie, kwalifikacje lub doświadczenie (należy spełniać jeden z poniższych warunków):
a) posiadać dokument potwierdzający uzyskanie kwalifikacji w następujących zawodach i specjalnościach: asystent osoby niepełnosprawnej, opiekun osoby starszej, opiekun medyczny, pedagog, psycholog, terapeuta zajęciowy, pielęgniarka, siostra PCK, fizjoterapeuta lub, za zgodą realizatora Programu, w innych zawodach i specjalnościach o charakterze medycznym lub opiekuńczym lub

2) Brak powiązań rodzinnych i programowych z uczestnikiem:
a) asystentem nie może być uczestnik programów Ministra finansowanych ze środków Funduszu Solidarnościowego dotyczących usług asystencji osobistej i opieki wytchnieniowej,

title: Front Office Supervisor  (Empfangschef/in (Hotel))
description:
Front Office Supervisor

Opis firmy

Tworzymy wyjątkowe miejsce dla naszych Gości dzięki wspólnej pasji do nowoczesnego designu i wysokiej jakości obsługi.

Już ponad 100 hoteli w 13 krajach imponują wyjątkowym designem, najwyższymi standardami obsługi i doskonałymi lokalizacjami w samym sercu miast.

Dołącz do naszego zespołu w Gdańsku!

Odkryj możliwości pracy w miejscu, gdzie liczy się pasja, zaangażowanie i chęć rozwoju!

Opis oferty pracy

Twoim priorytetem będzie troska o dobre samopoczucie Gości i Pracowników!

Twoje obowiązki będą obejmować również:

- Meldowanie Gości, sprawdzanie listy przyjazdów oraz innych raportów
- Zapewnienie profesjonalnej, najwyższej jakości obsługi
- Monitorowanie oraz reagowanie na opinie Gości

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Kwalifikacje

Czy posiadasz wyjątkową osobowość oraz doskonałe umiejętności z zakresu gościnności?

Jeśli tak, to idealnie będziesz pasować na to stanowisko! Nasze dodatkowe wymagania:

- Doświadczenie zawodowe w branży hotelarskiej
- Doskonałe wyczucie jakości i obsługi
- Otwartość, komunikatywność oraz bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego (w mowie i piśmie)
- Umiejętność pracy w zespole i gotowość do udzielania pomocy we wszystkich działach – wyniki osiąga się dzięki współpracy!
- Praca w godzinach porannych, popołudniowych i/lub nocnych

title: Senior Accountant Manager  (Leiter/in - Finanz- und Rechnungswesen)
description:
Senior Accountant Manager

Opis firmy

Ponad 100 hoteli w 13 krajach, które imponują wyjątkowym designem, najwyższymi standardami obsługi i doskonałymi lokalizacjami w samym sercu miast, a wszystko to w atrakcyjnej cenie. Jako założyciel i prekursor koncepcji budget design, z sukcesem rozwijamy się w metropoliach Europy i poza nią.

Opis oferty pracy

- Prowadzenie i nadzór nad księgowością operacyjną hoteli w Polsce zgodnie z obowiązującymi standardami oraz wytycznymi Centrali;
- Uzgadnianie rejestru VAT zakupu i sprzedaży;
- Raportowanie wyników finansowych dla hoteli w Gdańsku i Warszawie do Centrali, w tym analiza odchyleń oraz rekomendowanie działań korygujących.
- Ścisła współpraca z działem Controllingu, audytorami i pozostałymi działami hotelowymi w zakresie zagadnień finansowych, w tym obsługi procesów KSeF.
- Przygotowywanie przelewów do płatności, księgowanie wyciągów, rozliczanie kart kredytowych
- Przygotowywanie tygodniowych, miesięcznych i rocznych raportów finansowych zgodnie z wymaganiami działu kontroli finansowej.
- Czynny udział w procesach zamknięcia miesiąca, obejmujący uzgadnianie kont, kontrolę kosztów, inwentaryzację oraz weryfikację danych operacyjnych hoteli.
- Zapewnienie terminowego przygotowania dokumentacji do składania deklaracji podatkowych oraz zgodności z przepisami prawa podatkowego.
- Wsparcie w bieżących analizach finansowych oraz projektach związanych z optymalizacją kosztów i efektywnością operacyjną hoteli.
- Dbanie o prawidłowy obieg dokumentów w firmie oraz weryfikacja prawidłowości dokumentów księgowych

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Kwalifikacje

- Wyższe wykształcenie ekonomiczne;
- Min. 4 lata doświadczenia w dziale kontrolingu, mile widziane w branży hotelarskiej;
- Praktyczna, zaawansowana znajomość pakietu MS Office (w szczególności Excel);
- Znajomość języka angielskiego lub niemieckiego - warunek konieczny;
- Znajomość specyfiki finansów hotelowych (USALI) oraz wskaźników charakterystycznych dla branży hotelarskiej;
- Wysoko rozwinięte umiejętności analitycznego myślenia;
- Samodzielność oraz dobra organizacja pracy;
- Odpowiedzialność i terminowość;
- Gotowość do odbywania delegacji służbowych.

title: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description:
Operations and technicians

Teamlead Reliability Engineers

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.Pre-employment background checks:For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 120,000 employees spanning 75 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.

We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses -- Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology – and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end-to-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades.

What's more, we're reshaping the future by investing in innovation. WE MAKE TRADE FLOW
To Change What's Possible For Everyone

SENIOR NETWORK SECURITY ENGINEER (M/F/D)

Lódz, Poland | Hybrid (3-4 days onsite)

DP World, one of the world's leading logistics providers, is looking for a Senior Network Security Engineer (m/f/d) to join our European Network team in Lódz.

In this role, you will take ownership of our network security landscape across Europe, ensuring the stability, security, and continuous improvement of critical network infrastructure. You will act as a subject matter expert for network security technologies, work closely with Information Security and global IT teams, and support projects across multiple European locations. Please note that regular travel within Europe and occasional out-of-hours work are required.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

* Own and continuously improve the network security environment across Europe.
* Administer and enhance the Forescout NAC and network segmentation platform.
* Design, implement, and support secure LAN, WAN, Wireless, SD-WAN, and Firewall solutions.
* Manage Check Point and Palo Alto firewalls, IPS technologies, and vulnerability remediation activities.
* Collaborate with Information Security teams on threat detection, investigations, and security improvements.
* Support network projects end-to-end, including design, implementation, testing, documentation, and operational support.

YOUR PROFILE

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years of experience in enterprise network installation, configuration, and support.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with Forescout or similar NAC/segmentation technologies.
* Strong expertise in Cisco Routing, Switching, Wireless, and enterprise networking.
* Proven experience with Check Point and Palo Alto firewall technologies.
* Fluent English (at least C1), strong troubleshooting skills, and willingness to travel across Europe.

WHAT WE OFFER

* Permanent employment with a global and growing logistics leader
* Salary: PLN 91,663 – 145,800 gross per year*
* Private medical care (LUX MED)
* Group life insurance
* Employee Capital Plans (PPK)
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) supporting employees and their families
* Employment contract in an international logistics company

The final salary level will depend on the candidate's professional experience, skills, and qualifications.

title: TÉCNICO DE ENGENHARIA CIVIL
description:
Topógrafo - É o trabalhador que concebe, prepara, estuda, orienta e executa todos os trabalhos topográficos necessários à elaboração de planos, cartas, mapas, perfis longitudinais e transversais com apoio nas redes geodésicas existentes e ou nas redes de triangulação locais, por meio de figuras geométricas com compensação expedita (triangulação-quadriláteros) ou por interseção inversa (analítica ou gráfica), recorte ou por irradiação
direta ou inversa ou ainda por poligonação (fechada e compensada), como base de todos os demais trabalhos de levantamentos, quer clássicos quer fotogramétricos ou ainda hidrográficos, cadastrais ou de prospeção geológica. Determina rigorosamente a posição relativa de quaisquer pontos notáveis de determinada zona da  superfície terrestre, cujas coordenadas obtém por processos de triangulação, poligonação, trilateração ou outra.
Executa nivelamento de grande precisão. Implanta no terreno linhas gerais de apoio e todos os projetos de engenharia e arquitetura, bem como toda a piquetagem de pormenor. Fiscaliza, orienta e apoia a execução de obras públicas e de engenharia civil, na área da topografia aplicada, procedendo à verificação de implantações ou de montagem, com tolerâncias muito apertadas, a partir desta rede de apoio. Realiza todos os trabalhos
tendentes à avaliação de quantidades de obra efetuadas, a partir de elementos levantados por si ou a partir de desenhos de projeto e sempre também com base em elementos elaborados por si. Pode executar trabalhos cartográficos e de cadastro. Executa os trabalhos referidos e outros ligados às especialidades topográficas, com grande autonomia funcional.

description:
As a Senior AI Solution Architect in our Forward Deployed Engineering team, you see the whole board before a single line of code is written. You partner directly with business leaders across Siemens to map complex challenges to existing data, design cross-platform architectures spanning cloud and enterprise systems, and make critical build-versus-buy decisions in days rather than quarters. You bridge deep technical AI expertise with systems thinking, acting as a force multiplier that enables agile engineering teams to deliver high-impact solutions reliably and repeatedly.

What we offer you:

- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

You’ll make an impact by:

- Driving rapid solution architecture as the first technical expert in every engagement, translating complex business problems into viable technical blueprints within days. - Designing interconnected solutions across the entire enterprise landscape, leveraging SDC for workloads while integrating seamlessly with SAP, Salesforce, and cloud-native services. - Owning crucial architecture decisions regarding cost, latency, scalability, and stack selection, while documenting clear justifications for every trade-off. - Evaluating emerging AI technologies with rigorous skepticism, providing evidence-backed adoption recommendations and having the courage to say "not ready yet." - Staying actively involved in the codebase through technical spikes, prototype development, and pull-request reviews to ensure your architectures remain grounded in reality. - Designing from day one for seamless handover, establishing explicit interface contracts, evaluation harnesses, and operational runbooks so domain teams can run systems autonomously.

Your defining qualities:

- Education: You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or a comparable quantitative field, where a proven track record of shipped systems outweighs advanced degrees. - Experience & Skills:- You bring 8 or more years of experience in software architecture, AI/ML systems design, or solution architecture, including at least 3 years focused on complex enterprise AI solutions. - You demonstrate a robust history of customer-facing delivery and technical leadership, especially when navigating demanding or high-pressure stakeholder environments. - You posses hands-on coding capabilities in Python alongside TypeScript or JavaScript, allowing you to write production-grade code and build functional prototypes. - You provide expertise in cross-platform system design by successfully integrating disparate enterprise environments like SAP, Salesforce, and modern cloud services. - You exhibit deep knowledge of the modern AI stack, covering LLM failure modes, RAG architectures, evaluation metrics, vector stores, and prominent agent frameworks. - You bring working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP) sufficient to design scalable multi-platform workloads.
- Ways of working:- You demonstrate the critical ability to evaluate emerging technologies objectively, separate genuine value from hype, and communicate technical realities clearly. - You display exceptional live communication skills to sketch defensible architectures in real-time meetings and explain them fluently in business terms.
- Languages: You have fluent English language skills, complemented by strong German proficiency as an advantageous asset for local stakeholder engagements.

description:
LICENCIATURA EM ENFERMAGEM;
INSCRIÇÃO VÁLIDA NA ORDEM DOS ENFERMEIROS;
SENTIDO DE RESPONSABILIDADE E AUTONOMIA;

EXPERIÊNCIA EM CONTEXTO GERIÁTRICO (PREFERENCIAL).

title: TERAPEUTA OCUPACIONAL
description: ENTIDADE EM PORTIMÃO NECESSITA DE TERAPEUTA OCUPACIONALPARA DA EQUIPA TÉCNICA. OS PRINCIPAIS REQUISITOS SÃO LICENCIATURA EM TERAPIA OCUPACIONAL; CAPACIDADE DE TRABALHO EM EQUIPA MULTIDISCIPLINAR; BOA CAPACIDADE DE COMUNICAÇÃO E RELACIONAMENTO INTERPESSOAL; SENTIDO DE RESPONSABILIDADE, ORGANIZAÇÃO E COMPROMISSO; MOTIVAÇÃO PARA TRABALHAR NA ÁREA DA REABILITAÇÃO E APOIO À PESSOA COM DEFICIÊNCIA; AS PRINCIPAIS FUNÇÕES SÃO AVALIAÇÃO DAS NECESSIDADES E POTENCIALIDADES DOS/AS UTENTES; PLANEAMENTO E IMPLEMENTAÇÃO DE PROGRAMAS DE INTERVENÇÃO TERAPÊUTICA INDIVIDUALIZADOS; PROMOÇÃO DA AUTONOMIA, FUNCIONALIDADE E QUALIDADE DE VIDA; ARTICULAÇÃO COM A EQUIPA MULTIDISCIPLINAR, FAMÍLIAS E OUTROS INTERVENIENTES; ACOMPANHAMENTO E AVALIAÇÃO DA EVOLUÇÃO DOS/AS UTENTES.

title: ENFERMEIRO DE CUIDADOS GERAIS
description:
IPSS RECRUTA ENFERMEIRO/A, PARA AS SEGUINTES TAREFAS E FUNÇÕES:
- AVALIAR O ESTADO DE SAÚDE DOS RESIDENTES E ACOMPANHAR A SUA EVOLUÇÃO,
- ADMINISTRAR MEDICAMENTOS E OUTROS TRATAMENTOS PRESCRITOS;
- EFETUAR TRATAMENTOS E CUIDADOS DE ENFERMAGEM, INCLUINDO PENSOS E CUIDADOS DE FERIDAS;
- MONITORIZAR SINAIS VITAIS, COMO TENSÃO ARTERIAL, TEMPERATURA, PULSO E GLICÉMIA;
- IDENTIFICAR ALTERAÇÕES NO ESTADO DE SAÚDE DOS RESIDENTES E COMUNICAR AO MÉDICO OU À FAMÍLIA, QUANDO NECESSÁRIO;
- ACOMPANHAR RESIDENTES COM DOENÇAS CRÓNICAS E SITUAÇÕES DE DEPENDÊNCIA;
- PRESTAR CUIDADOS A RESIDENTES ACAMADOS OU COM MOBILIDADE REDUZIDA.

REQUISITOS:
- CAPACIDADE DE COMUNICAÇÃO E RELACIONAMENTO INTERPESSOAL;
- SENTIDO DE RESPONSABILIDADE, ORGANIZAÇÃO E PROFISSIONALISMO;
- CAPACIDADE DE TRABALHO EM EQUIPA E DE ARTICULAÇÃO COM DIFERENTES PROFISSIONAIS DE SAÚDE;
- EMPATIA, RESPEITO E SENSIBILIDADE MO RELACIONAMENTOCOM PESSOAS IDOSAS E DEPENDENTES.

title: AJUDANTE FAMILIAR
description: Garantir o bem-estar, a higiene, a alimentação e a segurança dos utentes, colaborando na manutenção e limpeza das instalações da instituição para assegurar um ambiente acolhedor e funcional. As Principais Funções serão os cuidados diretos ao utente, Prestar apoio na higiene pessoal, no vestir/despir, na alimentação e na mobilidade dos utentes.; Manutenção do espaço: Efetuar a limpeza e higienização dos quartos, salas comuns, casas de banho e outras áreas da instituição; Tratamento de roupas: Recolher, lavar, passar a ferro e organizar as roupas dos utentes e as roupas de cama/mesa da instituição; Apoio ao serviço de refeições: Ajudar na preparação, distribuição e recolha das refeições, bem como na lavagem da loiça e utensílios de cozinha; Vigilância e acompanhamento: Monitorizar o estado geral dos utentes, reportando imediatamente à equipa técnica (enfermeiros, assistentes sociais) qualquer alteração de comportamento ou de saúde.

title: AJUDANTE FAMILIAR
description: Procuramos um(a) profissional responsável, autônomo(a), organizado(a), com capacidade de trabalho em equipa, facilidade de relacionamento interpessoal e compromisso com a qualidade dos cuidados prestados e o respeito pela dignidade dos utentes; Disponibilidade para exercer funções no centro de dia e Serviço de apoio domiciliário; Disponibilidade imediata.

title: AJUDANTE FAMILIAR
description: Profissional responsável, empático e dinâmico, com gosto pelo apoio à pessoa idosa, capacidade de trabalho em equipa e experiência em cuidados de higiene, alimentação, mobilidade e conforto.

title: EDUCADOR DE INFÂNCIA
description: Organizar e aplicar os meios educativos adequados em ordem ao desenvolvimento integral da criança, nomeadamente psicomotor, afectivo, intelectual, social e moral, acompanhar a evolução da criança e estabelecer contactos com os pais no sentido de se obter uma acção educativa integrada.

The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

title: Špecialisti v oblasti databáz a počítačových sietí inde neuvedení
description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

title: Všeobecní administratívni pracovníci
description:
Hlavnou náplňou práce je agenda nadriadeného, organizácia stretnutí, vybavovanie služobných ciest, administratívna podpora – email manažment, telefonáty, bežná dokumentácia. Podpora predaja vozidiel v showroome. Plní okrem vyššie uvedenej agendy aj náročnejšie a častokrát aj vybrané odborné činnosti a úlohy v rámci vedenia firmy, ako HR, PR a marketing, finančný reporting, plánovanie. Pracovná doba typická pre pozíciu Asistent/ka na predajni nových vozidiel je 8 hodín denne, v pracovných dňoch od pondelka do piatku a v sobotu do 13:00 hod ( s možnosťou dohody ).
Výhody:- Možnosť kariérneho a platového rastu, kde Tvoje úsilie a výsledky budú ocenené. - Získanie služobného vozidla na základe odvedených výkonov, ktoré Ti umožní flexibilné cestovanie a rýchle presuny po meste. - Firemný notebook a telefón, ktoré Ti uľahčia komunikáciu a prácu na diaľku. - Príjemná pracovná atmosféra, kde sa budeš cítiť ako súčasť tímu a budeš mať podporu od skúsených kolegov. - Možnosť získať zaujímavé skúsenosti a pracovať s modernými vozidlami, ktoré Ti umožnia byť v kontakte s najnovšími trendy v automobilovom priemysle.

title: Špecialisti v oblasti predaja (okrem informačných a komunikačných technológií)
description:
Hľadáme ambiciózneho predajcu/predajkyňu, ktorý/á sa chce stať súčasťou nášho tímu. Ak Vás baví práca v automotive a komunikácia s ľuďmi, ste na správnom mieste. Vaše pracovné povinnosti budú: Aktívna komunikácia so zákazníkom smerujúca k uzatvoreniu obchodu. Zisťovanie potrieb zákazníkov, vykonávanie prezentácie nových automobilov. Vykonávanie administratívnych činností a vedenie obchodnej agendy spojenej s predajom automobilu. Vypracovanie cenových ponúk a návrhy riešenia potrieb podľa zákazníkov v oblasti financovania a poistenia nových vozidiel. Aktívna komunikácia a ponuka príslušenstva. Práca s informačným systémom. Zodpovednosť za splnenie plánu predaja automobilov. Starostlivosť o uskladnené nové vozidlá. Účasť na firemných eventoch a podujatiach.
Výhody:Mesačná mzda: 1300 € - 3000 €. Mzda sa skladá zo základnej zložky 1300 € z produktovej zložky, ktorú si ovplyvňuje predajca sám na základe dosiahnutých výsledkov z predaja. Z každého predaja predajca získava obratovú províziu, množstevný bonus, kvalitatívny bonus a kvartálny bonus závislý od objemu predaja. - možnosť osobného rastu - zamestnanecké ceny na produkty a služby - odborné certifikované produktové školenia - firemné akcie, teambuilding aktivity - individuálne ohodnotenie na základe dosiahnutých výsledkov

title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v oblasti informačných a komunikačných technológií
description:
Main responsibilities
Lead, support, and develop a team of Network Engineers.
Organize the team’s workload and coordinate operational and project priorities.
Ensure the availability, performance, and resilience of network infrastructure across multiple data centres.
Act as the primary escalation point for complex network incidents.
Coordinate incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
Review network configurations, planned changes, implementation procedures, and rollback plans.
Participate in network architecture, capacity planning, infrastructure expansion, and the deployment of new locations.
Establish technical standards and improve network-management procedures.
Promote the automation of repetitive configuration and operational tasks.
Monitor network performance, recurring incidents, operational risks, and service-quality indicators.
Coordinate maintenance activities with data centres, carriers, equipment vendors, and internal teams.
Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, configuration standards, and knowledge base materials.
Conduct one-to-one meetings, performance reviews, and technical-development planning.
Support recruitment, onboarding, mentoring, and knowledge sharing within the team.
Prepare operational reports and communicate technical risks and resource requirements to management.

Requirements
At least five years of professional experience in network engineering, telecommunications, hosting, or data-centre networking.
Previous experience leading, coordinating, or mentoring network engineers.
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, and network redundancy.
Advanced understanding of BGP and OSPF.
Strong knowledge of VLANs, xSTP, LACP, VRRP, and other Layer 2 and high-availability technologies.
Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise or service-provider network equipment.
Experience managing network changes in business-critical production environments.
Ability to diagnose complex connectivity, routing, performance, and packet-loss issues.
Experience with network monitoring, configuration management, IPAM, and incident-management tools.
Understanding of capacity planning, network resilience, and failure-domain design.
Ability to review technical solutions and make sound architectural decisions.
Strong leadership, prioritization, and incident-coordination skills.
English and Russian at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.
