Your profile
The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.

Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application.  

About us
Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not-for-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world-class education in a stunning alpine setting.
The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.
There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes.

What we offer
Aiglon is dedicated to the well-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages.

How to apply
Deadline for applications: 02.11.2026
Early applications are encouraged.  We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate.  Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered.

Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children.
Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.

You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s Privacy Notice.

JOB PURPOSE
The role of the Invigilator is to play a crucial part in maintaining the integrity, confidentiality, and security of the assessment and examination process. The Invigilator ensures that all examinations are conducted strictly according to required regulations, providing all candidates with an equal opportunity to demonstrate their abilities while preventing candidate malpractice and administrative errors. The invigilator also adheres to the school’s safeguarding policies and procedures at all times.
KEYS TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Conduct examinations in strict adherence to the regulations and guidelines of Aiglon College and relevant exam boards (including SAT, CollegeBoard, IB, JCQ, Pearson and CIE).
Ensure all candidates have an equal opportunity to demonstrate their abilities.
Safeguard and ensure the security of examination materials before, during, and after each examination.
Prevent potential candidate malpractice and administrative failures.
Follow the school’s safeguarding policies and procedures at all times.
Invigilators are required to:
Declare if they have invigilated previously and whether they have any current invigilation maladministration/malpractice sanctions applied to them.
Confirm their availability in advance of main examination periods.
Ensure a strong understanding of current exam board regulations, guidelines, and confidentiality requirements by studying provided materials.
Complete relevant invigilator training prior to examination periods or at the start of each academic year as directed.

An ideal candidate will:

Be reliable, flexible, and readily available during major exam periods.
Have clear, authoritative, yet calm verbal skills along with effective communication, interpersonal, and teamworking skills.
Be a confident, reassuring presence to candidates in examination rooms and effectively manage group situations.
Possess basic IT skills (e.g., familiar with the use of email and mobile messaging).
Seek to achieve competence in the role and a rigorous understanding of examination board regulations.
Have attention to detail, strict adherence to compliance and seating protocol.

Main duties in detail:

Before examinations
Report to and be briefed by the Exams Officer/SAT Coordinator prior to each exam session.
Keep confidential examination question papers and materials secure.
Ensure examination rooms are set up according to required arrangements.
Admit candidates into examination rooms under formal examination conditions.
Give full attention to conducting the examinations properly.
Identify candidates and seat them according to seating plans.
Distribute the correct question papers and examination materials to candidates.
Instruct candidates on the conduct of their exams and deal with candidate questions.
Start examinations on time.
During examinations
Supervise and observe candidates at all times and be vigilant throughout examinations.
Keep disruption in examination rooms to a minimum.
Deal with emergencies or irregularities effectively.
Record/report any incidents, disruption, or irregularities.
Complete attendance registers.
Record accurate start and finish times and track times updates.
Deal with candidate questions according to the regulations.
After examinations
Instruct candidates on finishing their examinations and collect all examination scripts in attendance register order.
Dismiss candidates from the examination room.
Check candidates' names on scripts and match details against the attendance register.
Securely return all examination scripts and materials to the Exams Officer/SAT Coordinator.

OTHER TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Supervise candidates with exam timetable clashes between sessions as required.
Provide support to candidates with access arrangements (e.g., reading, scribing), following provided training.
Assist with exam-related administrative tasks, such as "second pair of eyes" security checks.
Take part in invigilator training
Undertake any other reasonable tasks required by the Exams Officer/SAT Coordinator to support smooth exam operations.
Understand and implement all school policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people.
Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times.

Deadline for applications: **12\.10\.2026**



Early applications are encouraged. We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate. Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered.







Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children.



Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.



You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s .

Aiglon College is an international boarding school based in the Swiss Alps with a worldwide reputation for providing a challenging holistic education in an inspiring setting within a safe, caring, and supportive community. Each year, the Aiglon Programmes welcome over 600 students from more than 45 countries, offering a transformative experience while introducing students and their families to the Aiglon community.

Führung in einem der grössten Microsoft\-Teams der Schweiz \- hands\-on, nah an der Technik!

Teamlead Microsoft IT Services \- Zürich
=========================================

Wer braucht deine Verstärkung?
-------------------------------

Deine neue Herausforderung ist bei EveryWare, dem führenden Schweizer Cloud\- und IT\-Service\-Provider mit einer eigenen hochskalierbaren DataCenter\- und Netzwerk\-Infrastruktur in Zürich \- und mit Spezialisierung auf die Bedürfnisse von Businesskunden. Mit mehr als 20 Jahren Expertise konzipiert und betreibt das Unternehmen Private, Public und Hybrid Cloud Architekturen, Hosting und Managed IT\-Plattformen. Rund 250 Mitarbeitende, davon 90% spezialisierte Engineers, bringen internationale Innovationen praktikabel in Schweizer Unternehmen. Über 3000 Unternehmen sowie 30 Businesspartner haben EveryWare bereits als Partner gewählt. Über 200 erfolgreich realisierte Grossprojekte für Businesskunden, darunter auch Kunden aus der Banken\- und Versicherungsbranche, belegen die Kompetenz von EveryWare.



So schaffst du Mehrwert
-----------------------

Du baust ein Team innerhalb von EveryWares Microsoft IT Services auf \- eingebettet in eine Organisation mit 50\+ Engineers und fünf bestehenden Teams, die dasselbe tun. Du hast Peers, die wissen wie es geht, eine eingespielte Struktur um dich herum und trotzdem die Freiheit, dein Team nach deinen Vorstellungen zu formen.

Was dich konkret erwartet:

* Du führst dein Team disziplinarisch und fachlich: 1:1\-Gespräche, Kapazitätsplanung, Entwicklung der Teammitglieder.
* Du stellst Servicequalität und SLA\-Einhaltung gegenüber Kunden sicher und eskalierst, wenn nötig.

* Du übernimmst technische Projektleitung bei Migrationen, IT\-Outsourcing und Infrastruktur\-Upgrades.
* Du löst komplexe Probleme im 3rd\-Level\-Support und hältst Architekturbeschreibungen und Runbooks aktuell.


Das zeichnet dich aus
---------------------

Du bist keine Führungskraft, die sich vom Tagesgeschäft abgekoppelt hat. Du weisst noch, wie ein Runbook aussieht und kannst PowerShell lesen und schreiben. Gleichzeitig weisst du, wie man ein Team führt und weiterentwickelt \- in einem Umfeld, das technisch hohe Ansprüche stellt.

Was du mitbringst:

* 2\-3 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Teamlead\- oder Senior\- mit Personalverantwortung.
* Mehrjährige Praxiserfahrung mit Windows Server, Active Directory und Microsoft 365 \- aus dem Betrieb, nicht nur aus der Theorie.
* Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Azure und hybriden Infrastrukturen.

* PowerShell\-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit Automatisierung.

Dein neuer Arbeitsplatz befindet sich in einem einzigartigen Gebäude mit viel Charme \- im Herzen von Zürich. Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel und unzählige Lunchmöglichkeiten findest du in Fussnähe.

\& Training Supervisor, Travel Retail EMEA
==========================================











### **Role Summary**





We are looking for a sales\-oriented and high\-energy trainer/coach to join our team in Zürich. This role combines responsibility for boosting sales performance, coaching SENSAI advisors and Beauty Consultants (generic staff), and ensuring excellent retail execution, including visual merchandising and stock checks and advice.





The main priority of this position is field sales supervision. Coaching/training and retail excellence are keys secondary responsibilities.





Travels will be an important part of the position (60% to 70%) to meet our advisors on the field.

**1\) supervision (Primary Focus)**

* Monitor performance and execute improvement actions to increase sell out results.
* Drive counter performance by coaching SENSAI advisors and Beauty Consultants on cross\-selling/link\-selling techniques, service standards, and customer engagement.





**2\) Training, Coaching \& Knowledge Checks (Secondary Focus)**







* Train our SENSAI advisors and Beauty Consultants (generic staff) on product knowledge (demonstration, storytelling, Japanese cosmetics rituals, customer profiling, closing techniques).
* Motivate our own advisors and generic consultants thanks to a comprehensive program created and managed by the \& Training Supervisor.
* Plan, organize, and deliver online and physical training sessions and meetings.
* Conduct frequent knowledge questionnaires and verify after trainings, identify learning gapsand support follow\-up coaching.
* Ensure training actions materialise in growing sales.

* Ensure counters/shops align with brand standards (new launches, layout, presentation, testers, offers, signage, hygiene, cleanliness).

* management reporting out of stocks (saleable items and testers).
* Prepare reporting and presentations using Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint.
* Use Microsoft tools to support smooth communication and documentation.

title: Senior Packaging Technician, Operations (m/f/d) - [R408196]
description:
The Senior Packaging Technician is responsible for independently executing clinical packaging activities in compliance with internal specifications, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), batch records and applicable Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP)/ Good Documentation Practice (GDP) and Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) requirements. This role performs primary and secondary packaging, operates packaging and labelling systems, supports documentation and SAP transactions, coordinates routine technical tasks within assigned studies and serves as an experienced technical point of contact for day-to-day packaging activities.  

Key Responsibilities:

1. Clinical Packaging Operations
•    Performs primary packaging of clinical studies according to internal specifications, SOPs and batch records.
•    Performs secondary packaging of clinical studies according to internal specifications, SOPs and batch records.
•    Supplies ordered study material to the corresponding packaging rooms and prepares materials in accordance with the relevant SOPs.
•    Operates packaging and labelling systems in support of clinical packaging activities.

2. Technical Coordination
•    Trains and supports new technicians during onboarding and routine operations.
•    Performs administrative work related to packaging orders and clinical packaging activities.
•    Escalates problems directly to the supervisor or manager as required.
•    Coordinates the execution of bottle filling, labelling and packaging activities for clinical studies.
•    Oversees compliance-related aspects of packaging orders and serves as a technical point of contact for technicians assigned to individual studies.
•    Performs cleaning verification for equipment and rooms and completes final cleaning verification at study closeout.
•    Executes SAP transactions related to packaging activities.
•    Prepares GMP documentation, including required photographs, and creates batch notes or comments as applicable.
•    Reviews and coordinates Packaging Technicians’ activities within the assigned area.
•    Supports the transfer of cold materials as required during daily operations.  
•    Ensures study completion and hands over completed studies to the supervisor.

3. Routine Operational Tasks
•    Performs or coordinates routine tasks such as scale adjustments, deionized water flushes, and replenishment of consumables to support operational readiness.  
•    Provides day-to-day operational support to ensure readiness of packaging rooms, equipment and materials.
•    Supports the Packaging Compliance Support team with batch pre- and post-execution reviews.  

4. Documentation & Systems
•    Assists in document preparation, control and process improvement for packaging activities.
•    Uses SAP, Word and Excel for documentation and operational support, including the accurate completion of electronic logs.
•    Ensures accurate and compliant use of SAP for clinical packaging processes.

5. Compliance & EHS
•    Performs all activities in compliance with applicable SOPs, company policies, and GMP/GDP/EHS requirements.
•    Documents activities in accordance with internal GDP requirements.
•    Conducts blinding checks in accordance with SOP requirements.  

Your Profile:

•    Completed apprenticeship, preferably in a life sciences-related field.
•    At least 3 years of experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, clinical packaging, or a comparable GMP-regulated environment.  
•    Good understanding of GMP, GDP and EHS requirements relevant to packaging operations.
•    English language proficiency at B1/ B2 level or above.
•    Hands-on experience with packaging and labelling equipment and routine operational support activities.
•    Experience with documentation practices, batch records and accurate recording of operational activities.
•    Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office applications such as Word and Excel.
•    Ability to train and support other technicians and to serve as a technical point of contact for assigned studies.  
•    Reliable, detail-oriented and able to work independently while following procedures and compliance requirements.
•    Demonstrates strong ethics, compliance and quality mindset.
•    Strong team player with a collaborative mindset.  
•    Demonstrates a continuous improvement mindset in day-to-day operations and supports the implementation of procedural changes.

THE COMPANY

Our Company is a leading biopharmaceutical company employing over 1,000 people in Switzerland at three sites. The company’s headquarters are in Lucerne. At the site in Zurich, the company operates a global innovation and development hub. In addition, we manufacture medicines for global clinical trials and operate a forensic laboratory in Schachen (Canton Lucerne). We conduct around 40 clinical trials annually in Switzerland. The main therapeutic areas include oncology, infectious diseases, cardiovascular and cardiometabolic diseases. We also have a broad portfolio of vaccines for the prevention of diseases in children, adolescents, and adults and we are one of the leading companies in veterinary medicine. Furthermore, we take our responsibility to the local community seriously and have been involved for many years in initiatives such as the «Trendtage Gesundheit Luzern» and the «Alliance Health Competence».  

We are proud to be certified as a “Top Employer Switzerland” and “Top Employer Europe” showing the company’s commitment to our employees and the community around us.

Our Werthenstein BioPharma site in Schachen is where we conduct cutting-edge research, develop and analyze new biological agents and supply clinical trial products for global clinical studies. The site is also home to one of our global forensic laboratories where we carefully monitor our products through the supply chain to ensure security and safety for our patients.
